subject: Welcome to TrueCap — start your first property screen
preheader: Paste an address and review cap rate, cash flow, Buy Box fit, and a Deal score.
headline: You're in. Start with one property and verify the inputs.
body: Welcome to TrueCap. Paste a U.S. address and review cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, monthly cash flow, Buy Box fit, and a Deal score. Rent and mortgage rate can start from labeled HUD/FRED benchmarks; property tax is a manual local input. Verify every material input before relying on the result.
Try it on a property you're actually looking at right now. The fastest way to see if TrueCap fits how you work is to run a real deal, not a sample.
Reply to this email and tell me what you're hunting for — market, strategy, price range. I read every one.
